extraction_builder_lineage.assessment: Subsequent visible edits appear confined to analysis/reporting, but the repository cannot establish byte identity or reconstruct the exact executed extraction source from the hash alone.

provenance.extraction_metadata_correction: The immutable extraction metadata says Venhoff did not pin a runtime. That statement is incorrect: environment.yaml pins the software/CUDA runtime. V3 supersedes that statement without modifying the extraction artefact; only the HF model revision was unpinned.

official_runtime.interpretation: Venhoff's released environment pins the software/CUDA runtime; the model identifier is pinned only by name, not by Hugging Face revision.

provenance.provenance_status: unresolved provenance — the extraction records a builder SHA but the exact executed source file was not preserved; the local runtime also differs from Venhoff's pinned software/CUDA environment
provenance.runtime_difference: Official: CUDA, torch 2.5.1, transformers 4.47.1, NNSight 0.4.5. Local replay: MPS, torch 2.11.0, transformers 5.4.0; the extraction metadata records the exact local dtype. Only the official HF model revision was unpinned.

summary.gate_definition: all released counts exact; every selected-layer mean cosine >=0.999; every protocol-layer target-minus-overall direction cosine >=0.98

exact_official_vector_to_thesis_basis.limitations: Vector-to-subspace alignment only; not a Venhoff-cloud PCA result, not a steering-effect estimate, and still inherits the mixed-vintage thesis-basis provenance boundary.
exact_official_vector_to_thesis_basis.scope: Only two_by_two_alignment.*.cells.official_venhoff.thesis_mixed_vintage: exact released official direction from the hashed .pt measured against the independently reconstructed thesis basis. This result does not depend on the local model replay.

local_replay_cloud.reason: The strict reconstruction gate did not pass. Therefore the locally replayed activation-cloud PCA and every alignment cell using a local Venhoff cloud are not a reproduced Venhoff PCA result and are unlicensed for a claim about Venhoff's original activation cloud. They may be used only as explicitly conditional local-runtime sensitivities.
local_replay_cloud.scope: pca_cloud_metrics.released, pca_cloud_metrics.occurrence_aware, all two_by_two_alignment cells using venhoff_released, and all occurrence_aware_alignment_sensitivity cells
